#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long solve(long long n, long long m) {
    if (n > m) swap(n, m);
    long long res = n * m;
    if (n % 2 == 1 && m % 2 == 1) res--;
    if (n == 1) {
        long long x = ((n * m) / 6) * 6;
        long long y = (n * m) % 6;
        if (y == 4) x += 2;
        if (y == 5) x += 4;
        return x;
    }
    if (n == 2 && m == 2) return 0;
    if (n == 2 && m == 3) return 4;
    if (n == 2 && m == 7) return 12;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << solve(n, m) << "\n";

    return 0;
}
